basic_details.job_title: DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Legal Services Authority (Zila Vidhik Seva Pradhikaran), Rudraprayag, Uttarakhand, has 1 post of Office Peon (Karyalaya Paricharak) to fill on a contract basis for the Legal Aid Defense Counsel System office of Rudraprayag district. Candidates must submit the complete application, with all required records and certificates, at the District Legal Services Authority office, District Court Campus, Rudraprayag. They can hand it in in person or send it by registered post. It must reach the office by 5:00 PM on 13 November 2026.

qualification.details: The notice lists one post in its table of posts: | Educational qualification: Intermediate (इण्टरमीडिएट), as printed in the notice. Experience: The form has a field for experience "if any". The notice does not make experience compulsory. Character condition: The candidate should have no criminal history, meaning no case should have been run against the candidate. Nature of appointment: The appointment will initially be on contract for 01 year. It may be extended as required under the relevant rules and instructions. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: Selection for the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon post is through an interview. According to the press note
the interview will be held at the office of the District Legal Services Authority

on 16 November 2026 from 11:00 AM. Eligible candidates must make sure they attend on that date and at that time. The note on the application form adds that candidates will be informed separately about the interview date and time on their mobile numbers.
candidates must bring all the original documents whose photocopies were attached to the application. These are needed for verification.
important_instructions: Only the prescribed application format is accepted. It is available from the DLSA Rudraprayag office or at rudraprayag.dcourts.gov.in. Applications received after 05:00 PM on 13.11.2026 will not be considered, including those sent by registered post. Giving false, incomplete or concealed information can lead to cancellation of selection and legal action, as stated in the declaration. Contact details printed in the notice: phone 01364-233796, mobile 9410108263, email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About DLSA Rudraprayag
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Rudraprayag functions from the District Court Campus, Rudraprayag, in Uttarakhand. The notice is signed by the Civil Judge (Senior Division)/Secretary of the authority. This recruitment is for the district's Legal Aid Defense Counsel System office. It is made under the Legal Aid Defense Counsel System (Modified Scheme) 2022 of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA). It also follows the instructions in letter no. 2817/UKSLSA/2025-26 dated 29 October 2026 of the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority, Nainital.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made on the prescribed format. Candidates can get the form in person from the office of the District Legal Services Authority, Rudraprayag. They can also download it from the District Court Rudraprayag website, rudraprayag.dcourts.gov.in. The same form is printed as page 2 of the notice, under the title "Application form for selection of Office Peon". Get the prescribed application form from the DLSA Rudraprayag office, or download it from rudraprayag.dcourts.gov.in. Fill in the form and paste a colour passport size photograph in the box provided. Attach all the required records and certificates listed under Enclosures below. Sign the declaration, which says the details given are complete and true. It also says that the selection may be cancelled, and legal action may follow, if any information is found false, incomplete or concealed. Submit the complete application in person or by registered post to: District Legal Services Authority, District Court Campus, Rudraprayag. Make sure it reaches the office by 05:00 PM on 13.11.2026. Applications received after the fixed date and time will not be considered. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope. The form asks for the following details: Full name, in Hindi and in English capital letters. Father's or husband's name, in English capital letters. Date of birth (DD.MM.YYYY) and age. Caste and gender (male, female or transgender). Permanent address and correspondence address. Mobile number, WhatsApp number, email ID, Aadhaar number, educational qualification, any special qualification and experience, if any.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post in its table of posts: Educational qualification: Intermediate (इण्टरमीडिएट), as printed in the notice. Experience: The form has a field for experience "if any". The notice does not make experience compulsory. Character condition: The candidate should have no criminal history, meaning no case should have been run against the candidate. Nature of appointment: The appointment will initially be on contract for 01 year. It may be extended as required under the relevant rules and instructions. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice asks for the complete application with all necessary records and certificates. The application form names these documents: Colour passport size photograph, pasted on the form. Caste certificate. Certificate as proof of permanent address. Self-attested photocopy of the Aadhaar card. Self-attested photocopies of the educational qualification certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon post is through an interview. According to the press note, the interview will be held at the office of the District Legal Services Authority, Rudraprayag, on 16 November 2026 from 11:00 AM. Eligible candidates must make sure they attend on that date and at that time. The note on the application form adds that candidates will be informed separately about the interview date and time on their mobile numbers. When called for the interview, candidates must bring all the original documents whose photocopies were attached to the application. These are needed for verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Office Peon, for the Legal Aid Defense Counsel System office of Rudraprayag district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon application?
faq.answer: The complete application must reach the DLSA Rudraprayag office by 05:00 PM on 13 November 2026. Applications received later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon post?
faq.answer: The notice gives the educational qualification as Intermediate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon?
faq.answer: The pay printed in the notice is ₹12,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form and attach the required documents. Then submit it in person or by registered post at the District Legal Services Authority office, District Court Campus, Rudraprayag, by 05:00 PM on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I get the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon application form?
faq.answer: The form is available in person from the DLSA Rudraprayag office. It can also be downloaded from rudraprayag.dcourts.gov.in, and it is printed as page 2 of the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How will the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview at the DLSA Rudraprayag office on 16 November 2026 from 11:00 AM. The form also says candidates will be told the interview date and time on their mobile numbers.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract, initially for 01 year, and it may be extended as required under the relevant rules and instructions.

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring to the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon interview?
faq.answer: Bring all the original documents whose photocopies you attached to the application, for verification.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate with a criminal case apply for the DLSA Rudraprayag Office Peon post?
faq.answer: The notice states that the candidate should have no criminal history, meaning no case should have been run against the candidate.
